To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the most effective and robust performance measures are: (a) center location error (CLE); (b) overlap error (OE); (c) success plot (SP); (d) normalized average center location error (NACLE) and normalized average overlap error (NAOE).

1. the most popular performance measures are equivalent, and 2. the most popular visualization of tracker performance, the success plots, can be replaced with a simple accuracy-robustness visualization.

(i) the most popular performance measures are equivalent from information perspective; (ii) the measures are brittle and may be misleading; (iii) the most effective measures are accuracy and robustness; and (iv) the two measures are complementary.
